issues.title: Base dependencies include heavy ML packages
issues.description: torch, transformers, datasets, accelerate are in base[project.dependencies] instead of optional[ml]. This prevents a lightweight 'core' profile.
issues.recommendation: Move ML dependencies to optional[ml] profile; keep only pydantic, omegaconf, hydra-core in base

issues.title: No 'core' profile explicitly defined
issues.description: The intended 3-profile strategy is unclear. 'test-core' is defined but not 'core' or clear 'runtime' boundaries.
issues.impact: Users cannot install a minimal core package for scripting/APIs
issues.recommendation: Define explicit profiles: core (minimal), runtime (configs+ml+train), full (all)

issues.title: Profile size estimates unachievable
issues.description: Expected core 8-15MB but base deps already 200+MB due to torch. Runtime 20-35MB also unachievable.
issues.impact: Cannot deliver on packaging contract for package size optimization
issues.recommendation: Restructure base dependencies to only essential: omegaconf, hydra-core, pydantic, pyyaml, marshmallow

issues.title: 5 entry points expose private functions
issues.description: Entry points point to functions with _prefix which are implementation details, not public API.
issues.impact: Public plugin interface depends on unstable private APIs; breaking changes likely
issues.recommendation: Create public wrapper functions without _prefix; export from __init__.py

issues.title: 2 example plugin entry points missing
issues.description: examples.plugins.hello_plugin and metrics_token_accuracy_plugin do not exist
issues.impact: EntryPoint loading will fail if anyone tries to use these plugins
issues.recommendation: Either create these modules or remove from pyproject.toml

issues.title: 51 console scripts is excessive
issues.description: 51 CLI entry points spread across 8 modules (codex, codex_ml, cli, etc.)
issues.impact: Namespace pollution; difficult for users to discover core commands
issues.recommendation: Consolidate to ~5-8 primary commands: codex (core), codex-ml (ML), codex-tools (admin)

issues.title: Large __all__ exports in public modules
issues.description: Several modules export 30-48 items, likely including unstable internals
issues.impact: Bloats public API surface; internal changes break external code
issues.recommendation: Audit each module; keep __all__ to <10 stable exports; internalize rest with _prefix

issues.title: No [project.urls] section defined
issues.description: Missing documentation, repository, issue tracker links
issues.impact: PyPI displays minimal metadata; users cannot find docs/issues
issues.recommendation: Add [project.urls] with: Documentation, Repository, Issues, Changelog

issues.title: Lazy loading in __init__.py uses __getattr__
issues.description: src/codex/__init__.py uses __getattr__ for lazy imports (good), but pattern not consistent across packages
issues.impact: Type checkers and IDEs may not recognize lazy-loaded attributes
issues.recommendation: Document lazy loading pattern; add type stubs (.pyi files) for key modules

issues.title: No circular imports detected
issues.description: ✓ Scanned 1275 Python modules; no direct circular import cycles found
issues.impact: Good for distribution and lazy loading
issues.recommendation: Maintain this; add pre-commit check for circular imports

issues.title: Dependency boundaries unclear between profiles
issues.description: ml, configs, hydra, train, eval groups overlap with base. No clear separation.
issues.overlap_detected: test-core, ml, train, eval all depend on omegaconf/hydra/pyyaml
issues.impact: Cannot easily build minimal distributions; redundant transitive deps
issues.recommendation: Define core profile with NO torch/transformers; create dependency tree diagram
